title: Robust Dynamic Expansion for Continual Learning under Backdoor Attacks via Purification and Selective Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.06346v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning (CL) enables models to acquire new knowledge from sequentially arriving tasks while retaining previously learned knowledge. However, in practical scenarios, task streams collected from untrusted sources may contain backdoor-poisoned samples, posing a critical challenge to the stability, plasticity, and security of continual learners. In this work, we investigate a challenging setting termed Continual Learning Under Backdoor Attack (CLUBA), where each incremental task may involve a small proportion of maliciously manipulated training samples. Unlike conventional continual learning or backdoor defense scenarios, CLUBA requires models to simultaneously mitigate catastrophic forgetting, preserve adaptation capability, and prevent the absorption of malicious supervision during sequential updates. To address this challenge, we propose a robust dynamic-expansion framework that integrates sample purification, selective recover

translated_title: 基于净化与选择性恢复的后门攻击下持续学习鲁棒动态扩展方法
translated_abstract: 持续学习（CL）使模型能够从按顺序到达的任务中获取新知识，同时保留先前学到的知识。然而，在实际场景中，从不可信来源收集的任务流可能包含后门中毒样本，这对持续学习器的稳定性、可塑性和安全性构成了重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们研究了一个具有挑战性的新设定，称为后门攻击下的持续学习（CLUBA），其中每个增量任务可能包含少量恶意操纵的训练样本。与传统的持续学习或后门防御场景不同，CLUBA 要求模型在顺序更新过程中同时缓解灾难性遗忘、保持适应能力，并防止吸收恶意监督信息。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个鲁棒的动态扩展框架，该框架集成了样本净化与选择性恢复机制。
tldr: 该论文提出了后门攻击下持续学习（CLUBA）这一新设定，并设计了一个融合样本净化与选择性恢复的鲁棒动态扩展框架，使模型能够在序列学习过程中同时缓解灾难性遗忘并抵御恶意样本的污染。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CLUBA, a new setting of continual learning under backdoor attacks, and proposes a robust dynamic-expansion framework integrating sample purification and selective recovery to simultaneously mitigate catastrophic forgetting and resist malicious sample poisoning during sequential learning.
